fields.Name: Skip ICF - Dual-Axis Members vs Revenue with Drill-Down
fields.Description: Dual-axis chart of cumulative members and annual confirmed revenue 2019-2026 with three further drill levels. Ported from "Dual-Axis Time Series with 4-Level Drill-Down".

InputDefinition.userMessage: I need a dashboard showing membership and revenue trends from 2019 through 2026. Create a line chart with two Y-axes: the left axis shows total members (cumulative by join date) and the right axis shows confirmed order revenue per year, in different colours. When I click a year, open a pie chart of that year's revenue by product category. When I click a slice, show a table of the order lines in that category and year. Make every row clickable to open the order. Include clear axis labels, a legend, and titles that show the current selection. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a dual-axis line chart with members on the left axis and revenue on the right
Covers 2019-2026; revenue peaks in 2025 (about $868K confirmed) and 2026 is partial
Two distinct coloured series with a legend
Clicking a year opens a pie chart of that year's revenue by product category
Clicking a slice shows the order lines for that category and year with date, amount, product and person
Rows can open the underlying order record
Titles or breadcrumbs show the current selection at every level
